emails.subject: Motion to Continue Status Conference — routing due in 3 days
emails.body:
Hi Caleb,

This is an automated reminder from your Northgate Legal Client Portal.

Your signed Motion to Continue Status Conference is due to be routed in 3 days, ahead of its filing deadline.

If you'd like FilingDesk to route this filing on your behalf, just reply to this thread or send a Client Message and ask. The filing will be queued under your account for the supervising-attorney review queue before submission — typical turnaround 1 business day.

If you have questions about this filing, please contact your reviewing attorney Hannah Park, Esq. (Northgate Legal Civil Practice Group) or call our attorney line at +1 (855) NGL-LEGAL.

— Northgate Legal Services
